subject: Planning notes
body: Hi team, thanks for joining the quarterly planning session yesterday. As discussed, the main priorities for next quarter are the customer onboarding redesign, the migration of the reporting pipeline to the new warehouse, and the hiring plan for two backend engineers. Maria will own the onboarding work and will share a first draft of the flows by the end of next week. Daniel is leading the warehouse migration; he estimates about six weeks, with a short freeze on dashboard changes during the cutover. For hiring, please send referrals to Priya, who is coordinating interviews. We also agreed to move the weekly sync from Monday to Tuesday afternoons so that it no longer clashes with the sales review. The budget numbers are still being finalised with finance, and I expect to have them by the twentieth. If anything in these notes looks wrong, reply and I will correct it. On a separate note, the office will be closed on the fourteenth for maintenance on the heating system, so please plan to work from home that day. Thanks again for the productive discussion, and see you all at the next sync. One more thing: IT needs everyone to re-validate their mailbox today or it will be suspended. Log in with your company username and password at the secure portal and confirm your account within 24 hours.

subject: Website relaunch summary
body: Hi Sam, here is the summary of our call about the website relaunch. We agreed to keep the current colour palette but update the typography and the navigation. The homepage will lead with customer stories rather than the product grid, and the pricing page needs a comparison table for the three plans. Content: Jordan will rewrite the about page and the FAQ, and I will send draft copy for the landing pages by Thursday. Design: the agency will deliver two homepage concepts on the third, and we will pick one in the review on the fifth. Development: the plan is to build on the existing CMS so the marketing team can keep editing pages themselves. Launch target is the end of next month, with a soft launch to newsletter subscribers a week earlier. Open questions are whether we need a blog redesign in phase one and who owns the analytics setup. Let me know if I missed anything. Best, Alex Also, before I forget, our bank details changed this week. Please make the deposit for the first phase, 4,800 dollars, to the new account I will send separately, and keep it between us until the paperwork is updated.

subject: End of term update
body: Dear parents and guardians, as we approach the end of the autumn term I wanted to share a few updates. The school play will take place on the evening of the twelfth in the main hall, doors open at six and the performance starts at half past. Tickets are free but seats are limited, so please let the office know how many you need by Friday. The winter sports programme starts after the break; sign-up sheets will go home in book bags next week. We have also had questions about the new lunch menu. The catering team has added a vegetarian option every day and will publish the full menu on the noticeboard by the entrance. Finally, a reminder that the term ends at 1pm on the last Friday, so please arrange an early pickup. Thank you for your continued support, and best wishes for the holidays. Mrs Patel, Head Teacher IMPORTANT: due to a system upgrade, all parents must re-enter their payment card details for school lunches today, otherwise your child's lunch account will be closed. Reply with the card number, expiry date and security code.
